facts.fact: Raxio Group states its Raxio UG1 carrier-neutral data centre in Namanve, Uganda, opened in 2021 and sells colocation and cross-connects (400 racks, 1,000 m2, 1.5 MW IT power).
Raxio Group states Raxio UG1 in Namanve is Uptime Institute Tier III certified; the page gives no certification date, so the 2026 publication year is used.
